description: Spec §4 RED item (c) requires TWO assertions for barge-in: (1) routeGeminiMessage returns {kind:'interrupted'} — covered by lib/call-bridge.test.js:12-21; AND (2) 'in a server-handler test' that a `{"event":"clear"}` object is carrierSent. Only (1) exists. The actual wiring that matters for the real call — server.js's gemini `message` handler doing `if (r.kind === "interrupted") carrierSend({ event: "clear" });` (server.js:408) — is never exercised by any test. Grep across apps/life-call for the literal string `carrierSend` / `{event:"clear"}` in *.test.js files returns zero hits (only server.js and lib/call-bridge.cjs/.test.js reference 'interrupted' at all, and call-bridge.test.js never touches carrierSend). If a future edit changes server.js's `if (r.kind === "interrupted") carrierSend(...)` line (e.g. typo'd event name, wrong socket, or an accidentally-removed condition), no test would fail — the barge-in feature could silently regress to talking over the caller (the exact bug Goal 1 is trying to fix) with 100% green CI.
